title: Knowing the beautiful Seville with my family

author: Q1816ISjavierb

title: Highly Recommended Engaging Experience of this Ancient City
text: This was my third visit to Seville. So, I was looking for a tour that would enhance my knowledge of the city’s history and its neighbourhoods. This tour did not disappoint. We met Vicky at the Torre del Oro on an unusually cold morning in Seville and from the moment we began our tour we knew we were with a guide with great insights and storytelling skills. We really enjoyed Vicky’s sense of humour as she brought the stories of this ancient city to life. We got to ask lots of questions along the way and Vicky met all our expectations.
author: Travel60618792792
